title: Inter-modality Representational Overlap Analysis
design: Extract patient-level embeddings from UNI2 and GigaPath for SWG and TCGA pools. Compute Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), Pearson/Mutual Information matrices, and variance partitioning across modalities. Plot fusion delta against inter-modality correlation strength.
decisive_result: A strong inverse correlation between fusion gain and inter-modality redundancy proves that replication failure is caused by representational overlap (modalities encoding the same visual features) rather than missing biological signal, directly explaining the UNI2-vs-GigaPath sign flip.

title: Entropy-Weighted Training for Label Ambiguity
design: Retrain ERIN progression ABMIL models using cross-entropy weighted by 1-max(probability) or jury-reported entropy, instead of uniform loss. Evaluate performance separately on confident vs held-out unsure cases, and report calibration slope/Brier score.
decisive_result: Entropy-weighted training improves Harrell’s C-index on the unsure holdout by ≥0.05 without degrading confident-case performance, proving that explicit uncertainty modeling converts discarded label noise into measurable predictive utility.
compute: ~3 GPU-hours (standard MIL retraining with modified loss)

title: Attention-to-Molecular Attribution Mapping
design: Export final-fold ABMIL attention weights per tile. Bin tiles into high/low attention, extract corresponding sWGS coverage/mutation calls for SWG patients. Predict TP53/WGD status from high-attention region features and compare against randomly sampled tile sets matched for area.
decisive_result: High-attention regions significantly outperform random tiles (ΔAUC > 0.10, p<0.01) in genotype prediction, providing a quantitative, visually-grounded mechanism linking morphological phenotype to molecular drivers and strengthening Ch2’s biological plausibility.

title: Clinical-Leakage Quantification via Temporal Ablation
design: Train clinical-only Cox models on ERIN progression with three configurations: (a) full clinical including prior-grade, (b) prior-grade dropped, (c) synthetic lagged prior-grade from historical cohorts. Compare C-index drops and run permutation tests to isolate the leakage component.
decisive_result: Dropping prior-grade reduces clinical arm C-index by <0.02, confirming that temporal leakage drove most of the clinical signal. This formally isolates histology as the only non-leaky predictor, sharpening the thesis argument on why unimodal fusion remains necessary.

title: Disagreement-Ranked Active Annotation Simulation
design: Rank all ERIN reports by jury entropy × pairwise disagreement rate. Simulate an active-learning loop: sequentially query top-k uncertain reports, assign ground truth via adjudication availability or controlled noise injection, retrain models, and plot validation AUC gain per annotated sample against random/baseline sampling.
decisive_result: Entropy-disagreement ranking yields >40% faster convergence to target AUC versus random sampling, establishing LLM disagreement metrics as optimal guides for expert annotation and opening a standalone methods chapter on scalable supervision validation.

title: Randomized Cross-Modal Connection Baseline
design: Implement three structurally identical ABMIL-fusion networks with frozen histology features but randomized initial fusion weights and shuffled cross-modal connectivity tensors. Train for 2 epochs and record OOF predictions across all cohorts to establish a structural null distribution.
decisive_result: Learned models consistently exceed randomized architecture baselines by >0.10 AUC/C-index across all tasks, formally ruling out architectural overfitting and confirming that multimodal integration captures genuine cross-modal signal rather than spurious parameter correlations.
compute: ~6 GPU-hours (trivial weight init, fast early-stopping convergence)

title: Projection Alignment to Recover Collapsed Fusion
design: Apply orthogonal Procrustes alignment or a lightweight contrastive projector to map GigaPath embeddings into the UNI2 latent space. Retrain late-fusion heads on aligned embeddings and recompute paired bootstrap deltas against histology-only baselines.
decisive_result: Post-alignment fusion delta recovers a positive sign with excluded-zero CIs, proving that representation incompatibility—not biological irrelevance—causes replication failure, and providing a fixable protocol for future encoder swaps.

title: Time-Dependent Decision-Curve Utility for Surveillance
design: Re-evaluate ERIN progression models using time-dependent AUC at 1, 2, and 3 years. Generate decision-curve analysis calibrated to UK surveillance guidelines (e.g., immediate biopsy if predicted risk >5%, 2-year repeat otherwise). Compare net benefit of histology-only vs histology+clinical at these thresholds.
decisive_result: Fusion achieves statistically significant net benefit only at short-interval surveillance thresholds (<10% risk), while pure histology maintains benefit across broader ranges, precisely quantifying when clinical context aids decision-making and when it degrades calibration.
compute: ~2 GPU-hours (time-dependent survival evaluation + decision curve package)
